occasions.title: Shraddha: Late Vasant Joshi (Ajoba)
occasions.heritageNotes: Inaugurated following Ajoba’s departure in Magha 1988; unbroken annual tithi observance faithfully kept across three generations.
occasions.confirmedSource: Confirmed by Aaji & Pt. Shrikant Joshi (Datar Panchang p. 42)
occasions.practiceNotes: Annual death-anniversary tithi. Performed at home before noon. Cow grass (Gau-grasa) and charity given to local vedic pathashala.

mr.title: कै. वसंत जोशी (आजोबा) यांची पुण्यतिथी / श्राद्ध तिथी स्मरण
mr.body: येत्या रविवारी, २८ फेब्रुवारी २०२७ रोजी कै. वसंत जोशी यांची श्राद्ध तिथी (माघ कृष्ण सप्तमी) आहे. हे स्मरण पुणे सूर्योदयानुरूप निश्चित केले आहे.
prepList: काळे तीळ, दर्भ, सातूचे पीठ आणि कापूर आदल्या दिवशी तयार ठेवा.
ब्राह्मण भोजनाची अथवा शिध्याची वेळ सकाळी ११:३० ते १२:३० दरम्यान अनुकूल आहे.
गायीसाठी गोग्रास व पानाचा नैवेद्य राखून ठेवावा.

hi.title: पूज्य दादाजी (कै. वसंत जोशी) का वार्षिक श्राद्ध स्मरण
hi.body: आगामी रविवार, २८ फरवरी २०२७ को पूज्य दादाजी कै. वसंत जोशी की श्राद्ध तिथि (माघ कृष्ण सप्तमी) है। यह तिथि पुणे के स्थानीय सूर्योदय अनुसार नियत की गई है।
prepList: काले तिल, कुश (दर्भ), जौ का आटा और कपूर पहले से एकत्र कर लें।
ब्राह्मण भोजन व तर्पण का समय दोपहर ११:३० से १२:३० बजे सबसे उपयुक्त है।
गाय और कौवे के लिए प्रथम ग्रास अलग निकालें।

en.title: Annual Shraddha Tithi: Late Vasant Joshi (Grandfather)
en.body: Coming up on Sunday, 28 February 2027 is the Shraddha Tithi for Grandfather Vasant Joshi (Magha Krishna Saptami), observed as per Pune home sunrise.
prepList: Keep black sesame seeds, darbha grass, barley flour, and camphor ready.
Ritual & meal timings are observed between 11:30 AM and 12:30 PM.
Reserve the traditional offering (gau-grasa) for cows and charity.

occasions.title: Aaji's Birthday (Tithi-Based)
occasions.heritageNotes: First recorded in family Janma Patrika on Nagpanchami 1948; traditional aarti and elders’ blessings celebrated each year.
occasions.practiceNotes: Aaji turns 79. Celebrated by tithi on Nagpanchami day. Grandchildren seek blessings; sweet puran poli or payasam is prepared.

occurrence2027.tithiSpan: Shravana Shukla Panchami lasts till 11:45 PM

mr.title: आजींचा तिथीनुसार वाढदिवस (श्रावण शुक्ल पंचमी)
mr.body: येत्या शनिवारी, ७ ऑगस्ट २०२७ रोजी आजींचा तिथीनुसार वाढदिवस आहे. आपण सर्व मिळून त्यांना शुभेच्छा देऊया व आशीर्वाद घेऊया!
mr.wish: आदरणीय आजी, वाढदिवसाच्या हार्दिक शुभेच्छा! आपल्याला उत्तम आरोग्य, दीर्घायुष्य आणि मनःशांती लाभो हीच ईश्वरचरणी प्रार्थना. - आपला जोशी परिवार.

hi.title: दादीजी का तिथी अनुसार जन्मदिन (श्रावण शुक्ल पंचमी)
hi.body: शनिवार, ७ अगस्त २०२७ को दादीजी का तिथी अनुसार जन्मदिन है। पूरे परिवार की ओर से उन्हें नमन और शुभकामनाएं।
hi.wish: पूज्य दादीजी, जन्मदिन की अनंत शुभकामनाएं! ईश्वर से आपके उत्तम स्वास्थ्य, दीर्घायु और सुख-शांति की प्रार्थना है।

en.title: Aaji's Tithi Birthday (Shravana Shukla Panchami)
en.body: Coming Saturday, 7 August 2027 is Aaji's birthday as per the traditional tithi (Nagpanchami). Forward your warm wishes and call her for blessings!
en.wish: Dearest Aaji, wishing you a joyous and blessed birthday! May God grace you with vibrant health, peace, and long life. With all our love.

occasions.title: Aniket's Birthday (Calendar Date)
occasions.heritageNotes: First recorded upon Aniket’s birth on 14 October 2012 in Pune; celebrated each year with family blessings.
occasions.practiceNotes: Kept by Gregorian date (14 October). Turning 15 in 2027.

mr.title: अनिकेतचा वाढदिवस (१४ ऑक्टोबर)
mr.body: १४ ऑक्टोबर रोजी अनिकेत १५ वर्षांचा होत आहे! अनिकेतला कौतुक आणि खूप खूप शुभेच्छा.
mr.wish: प्रिय अनिकेत, वाढदिवसाच्या अनेक उत्तम शुभेच्छा! तुझ्या अभ्यासात आणि सर्व छंदात तुला उत्तम यश लाभो.

hi.title: अनिकेत का जन्मदिन (१४ अक्टूबर)
hi.body: १४ अक्टूबर को अनिकेत का जन्मदिन है! अनिकेत को स्नेह और हार्दिक शुभकामनाएं।
hi.wish: प्रिय अनिकेत, जन्मदिन की ढ़ेरों बधाई! तुम जीवन में खूब तरक्की करो और स्वस्थ रहो।

en.title: Aniket's Birthday (14 October)
en.body: Aniket turns 15 on Thursday, 14 October! Don't forget to send him your wishes.
en.wish: Happy Birthday Aniket! Wishing you a wonderful year ahead filled with learning, laughter, and high scores!

occurrence2027.tithiSpan: Bhadrapada Shukla Chaturthi (Madhyahna Muhurat 11:15 AM - 01:42 PM)

mr.title: श्री गणेश चतुर्थी (बाप्पांचे आगमन)
mr.body: शनिवार, ४ सप्टेंबर २०२७ रोजी श्री गणेश चतुर्थी आहे. घरात ५ दिवसांच्या बाप्पांचे स्वागत होईल. मध्यान्ह प्रतिष्ठापना मुहूर्त ११:१५ ते दुपारी ०१:४२.
prepList: पाट, रांगोळी, दुर्वा, जास्वंदाची फुले आणि मोदकाची तयारी आदल्या दिवशी करा.
घरातील पूजेचे साहित्य व सुट्टे नाणी वेळेत तयार ठेवा.

hi.title: श्री गणेश चतुर्थी महोत्सव
hi.body: शनिवार, ४ सितंबर २०२७ को श्री गणेश चतुर्थी है। दोपहर प्रतिष्ठापना मुहूर्त पूर्वाह्न ११:१५ से दोपहर ०१:४२ तक है।
prepList: दूर्वा, लाल गुड़हल फूल, मोदक प्रसाद की सामग्री तैयार रखें।
पूजन स्थल को स्वच्छ कर रंगोली बनाएं।

en.title: Ganesh Chaturthi (Family Observance)
en.body: Saturday, 4 September 2027 is Ganesh Chaturthi. The Joshi family hosts Bappa for 5 days. Auspicious sthapana window: 11:15 AM - 01:42 PM.
prepList: Procure fresh durva grass, red hibiscus flowers, modak ingredients.
Prepare the wooden altar (paat) and rangoli on Friday evening.

occasions.title: Angarki Sankashti Chaturthi (Special Vrat)
occasions.heritageNotes: Special family sankalpa taken during Angarki yoga in 1991 for family wellbeing and uninterrupted prosperity.

mr.title: संकष्टी चतुर्थी उपवास व चंद्रोदय
mr.body: २७ मार्च २०२७ रोजी संकष्टी चतुर्थी आहे. उपवास करणाऱ्यांसाठी पुणे येथील चंद्रोदय वेळ रात्री ९ वाजून १८ मिनिटे आहे.
prepList: चंद्राला अर्घ्य देण्यासाठी दुर्वा व पाणी तयार ठेवावे.
मोदक किंवा उपवासाची खीर तयार ठेवा.

hi.title: संकष्टी चतुर्थी व्रत व चंद्रोदय समय
hi.body: २७ मार्च २०२७ को संकष्टी चतुर्थी व्रत है। पुणे में चंद्रोदय का समय रात्रि ०९:१८ बजे रहेगा।
prepList: चंद्र दर्शन हेतु कच्चा दूध, जल व रोली तैयार रखें।

en.title: Sankashti Chaturthi Vrat & Moonrise
en.body: Saturday, 27 March 2027 is Sankashti Chaturthi. For those observing the fast, moonrise in Pune is at 09:18 PM.
prepList: Keep arghya offering ready for the moon after 09:18 PM.

occasions.practiceNotes: Milestone memory: In 1998, Aaji and Late Ajoba completed the house in Pune. 29 years of blessings in 2027.

mr.title: आपल्या कुटुंबाची आठवण: पुणे घराचा गृहप्रवेश (१९९८)
mr.body: २२ नोव्हेंबर १९९८ रोजी आजोबा आणि आजी यांनी पुणे घराचा गृहप्रवेश केला होता. आज या घराला २९ वर्षे पूर्ण झाली आहेत. घरच्या सर्वांना खूप प्रेम!

hi.title: पारिवारिक संस्मरण: पुणे गृह प्रवेश (१९९८)
hi.body: २२ नवंबर १९९८ को दादाजी और दादीजी ने पुणे निवास का गृहप्रवेश किया था। घर के २९ वर्ष पूरे होने पर सभी को मंगलकामनाएं।

en.title: Today in Our Family: Pune House Griha Pravesh (1998)
en.body: On 22 November 1998, Aaji and Late Ajoba held the housewarming (Griha Pravesh) for the family home in Pune. Celebrating 29 wonderful years of family memories.

occasions.heritageNotes: Ekadashi vrata niyama observed continuously since 1980 by Aaji and family elders.
occasions.practiceNotes: Aaji observed full-day upvas. Fruits and sabudana khichdi prepared at home.

lineageMembers.name: Late Vasant Joshi
lineageMembers.bio: Founding elder of the contemporary Joshi lineage. The annual shraddha tithi is strictly observed on Magha Krishna Saptami in Pune as per local sunrise convention.

responsibilities.occasionTitle: Late Vasant Joshi Annual Shraddha Tithi
responsibilities.dutySummary: Ancestral soul honored with annual Vedic pindadana and tarpana.
checklist: Sacred offerings dedicated in his memory
Tarpana with black sesame seeds and Kush darbha grass
Sidha dakshina & gau-grasa delivered to local Vedic Pathashala
responsibilities.notes: Observed at midday (11:30 AM - 12:30 PM) at the ancestral residence in Pune.

responsibilities.dutySummary: Remembered during the sacred ancestor fortnight with sacred water offerings.
checklist: Joint family sankalpa invokes his name and gotra (Kashyapa)
Annadanam distributed to the needy in Pune

lineageMembers.name: Malati Joshi
lineageMembers.primaryRole: Family Matriarch & Oral Tithi Guardian (कुलमाता व स्मृती रक्षक)
lineageMembers.bio: Elder matriarch (age 78) holding the oral memory of ancestral dates, vows, and traditional recipes. Received heartfelt family reverence on her birthday tithi (Phalguna Shukla Dwadashi).

responsibilities.dutySummary: Family gathers to perform auspicious aukshan and receive her blessings.
checklist: Aukshan (ओवाळणी) by children and grandchildren
Bless the entire family with health and unbroken lineage harmony
Traditional family lunch with puran poli prasad

responsibilities.dutySummary: Guides the Sanskrit Lakshmi stotra recitation and traditional thali arrangement.
checklist: Inspect the silver coins, coriander seeds, and batasha offerings
Lead the chanting of Shri Sukta with family members
Place the first consecrated sweet before Khandoba altar

responsibilities.dutySummary: Verifies the ancestral tithi tradition and guides satvik kitchen preparation.
checklist: Confirm date match with Datar Panchang pages
Supervise ancestral dish preparation without onion/garlic
Ensure cow grass (gau-grasa) is set aside prior to human meal

lineageMembers.name: Bhushan Joshi
lineageMembers.primaryRole: Chief Karta & Ritual Configurator (मुख्य कर्ता व यजमान)
lineageMembers.bio: Primary ritual host residing at the ancestral house in Pune. Responsible for sunrise tithi calculations, priest coordination, and maintaining KulLoop family records.

responsibilities.dutySummary: Chief performer of Vedic tarpana and Brahmana samaradhana.
checklist: Observe fast and wear ceremonial dhoti before 11:00 AM
Coordinate with Pt. Shrikant Joshi for midday home arrival
Perform ancestral tarpanam with Kush grass, black sesame, and water
Hand over dakshina and sidha samagri respectfully

responsibilities.dutySummary: Leads the family Lakshmi-Kubera aarti and account book consecration.
checklist: Prepare Chopda / digital ledger for auspicious ink mark
Perform joint sankalpa with spouse Radhika at 06:15 PM Pradosh Kaal
Lead aarti with conch sound and camphor flame
Distribute prasad to all family members and staff

responsibilities.dutySummary: Calculates Pune moonrise and conducts Ganapati puja.
checklist: Verify exact moonrise minute in Pune
Offer 21 fresh durva blades and modak naivedya
Break day-long fast after Chandradarshana and arghya offering

lineageMembers.name: Radhika Joshi
lineageMembers.primaryRole: Puja Coordinator & Naivedya Custodian (नैवेद्य व पाकसंस्कार)
lineageMembers.bio: Oversees the ritual kitchen, auspicious threshold rangolis, and pristine samagri preparation for every festival and shraddha observance.

responsibilities.dutySummary: Prepares traditional coriander-jaggery prasad and sacred floor designs.
checklist: Draw auspicious lotus and footprint rangolis at entrance
Prepare dhane-gul (coriander seeds & jaggery) and panchamrita
Arrange 21 pure cow ghee earthen lamps across the house

Prepare separate leaf plates for Pitru Naivedya and Gau-grasa
Keep brass water vessels filled and polished for ritual use

lineageMembers.bio: Residing in Canada, bridging ancestral tithis across 9.5-hour time zone difference. Ensures next-generation diaspora youth Maya stays connected to her roots.

checklist: Schedule cross-timezone video call (morning Toronto, evening India)
Prepare decorative aarti thali with daughter Maya
Send auspicious shagun transfer to younger cousins

responsibilities.dutySummary: Sponsors charitable giving and maintains quiet contemplation abroad.
checklist: Sponsor local food bank or tree planting in grandfather’s memory
Read Chapter 15 of Shrimad Bhagavad Gita during Pune ritual hour
Share stories of grandfather with daughter Maya

lineageMembers.name: Rajesh Joshi

lineageMembers.bio: Oversees Northern pilgrimage connections, procuring sacred Ganga water for family rites and participating in joint Pitrupaksha rituals.

responsibilities.dutySummary: Arranges sanctified Ganga jal from Haridwar and participates in simultaneous tarpana.

Observe strict morning fast and recite Pitru Sukta
Offer evening deepa dana on the banks of Yamuna in Delhi

responsibilities.dutySummary: Performs Lakshmi puja in Delhi aligned with family muhurat.
checklist: Light threshold lamps in Delhi home
Join family group video call for joint aarti chant

lineageMembers.name: Aniket Joshi
lineageMembers.primaryRole: Apprentice Karta & Memory Archivist (युवा वारसदार व स्मृती संकलक)
lineageMembers.bio: College student learning the intricacies of traditional tithis and rituals from Aaji and Bhushan. Captures photos and curates the KulLoop Memory Slot.

responsibilities.dutySummary: Assists father during tarpanam and procures traditional samagri.
checklist: Visit Tulshibaug market on prior evening for darbha grass and black sesame
Assist in pouring sacred water during ritual tarpanam
Capture archival photo of the family gathering for KulLoop Memory Slot

responsibilities.dutySummary: Prepares puja space, audio stotras, and photography.
checklist: Place marigold garlands and mango leaves at the doorframe
Set up the audio recording for family Lakshmi Aarti
Distribute prasad sweets to elders and neighbors

lineageMembers.name: Maya Patil
lineageMembers.bio: High school student learning her mother’s ancestral Marathi customs, Devanagari script, and celebrating Diwali with handmade clay lamps.

responsibilities.dutySummary: Paints diyas and joins the family global video blessing.

Recite Gayatri Mantra and join family video call with Aaji

lineageMembers.name: Aarav Joshi
